notes.title: Debugging of moving boxes
notes.notes: The moving boards standing on the sea were getting caught in the waves and moving away from their position, this problem has been fixed and now they do not leave the specific area.

notes.title: MOVING LOGS FIXED
notes.notes: In the late game, moving logs were moving away from their position due to waves, so the player could not complete the game, we fixed this issue and the end of the game can be reached smoothly.
